query: WITH starts AS (SELECT o.workflow_uuid,o.output::jsonb->'json'->>'routineName' AS routine_name FROM dbos.operation_outputs o JOIN dbos.workflow_status w USING(workflow_uuid) WHERE o.function_name='routine-fire-start' AND w.name='routineFire' AND o.started_at_epoch_ms>=extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-10-28 00:00:00+00')*1000 AND o.started_at_epoch_ms<extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-10-29 00:00:00+00')*1000 AND o.output::jsonb->'json'->>'workspaceId'='papercusp-workspace' AND o.output::jsonb->'json'->>'installSlug'='papercusp' AND o.output::jsonb->'json'->>'routineName' IN ('fleet-headcount-governor','external-trigger-dispatch','personal-vault-import')) SELECT s.routine_name,count(*)::int AS actual_started_fires,count(a.workflow_uuid)::int AS action_records,count(a.completed_at_epoch_ms)::int AS completed_action_records,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY (a.completed_at_epoch_ms-a.started_at_epoch_ms)) AS action_wall_p50_ms,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY (a.completed_at_epoch_ms-a.started_at_epoch_ms)) AS action_wall_p95_ms,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.error IS NOT NULL)::int AS action_error_records,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.output::jsonb->'json' IS NULL OR a.output::jsonb->'json'='null'::jsonb)::int AS action_output_without_value,array_agg(DISTINCT w.application_version) AS application_versions FROM starts s JOIN dbos.workflow_status w USING(workflow_uuid) LEFT JOIN dbos.operation_outputs a ON a.workflow_uuid=s.workflow_uuid AND a.function_name='system:'||s.routine_name GROUP BY s.routine_name ORDER BY s.routine_name
limitations: DBOS operation elapsed milliseconds measure wall time, not CPU.
These actions discard their useful counters or return void; absent output is not proof of no-op.
No-op share, idle CPU and per-fire DB query cost are unknown from this retained ledger.
A scheduling go cannot be justified by unknown costs or cron arithmetic.
